description: A contract-first RPC framework over HTTP/2 with binary Protobuf messages, generated clients and unary or streaming calls.
The Protobuf contract that defines services and messages, compiled by `Grpc.Tools` into a service base class and a client at build time.
The numeric tag of a Protobuf field that identifies it on the wire, which must never be reused or changed once published.
The UTC time by which a gRPC call must finish; there is no default, and exceeding it throws `DeadlineExceeded` on the client and cancels the server's token.
A server class whose public methods clients call and through which the server pushes messages to all clients, groups or users over persistent connections.
The service used to send hub messages from code outside the hub, such as a background worker.
A shared channel, such as Redis or Azure SignalR Service, that forwards hub messages between server instances so every connected client receives them.
